sourceNote: SENER PRODESEN 2024-2038 anchor: ~1.2% of renewable generation curtailed in 2022 (~1 TWh) due to transmission-network saturation and CENACE operational restrictions, primarily in the northern grid (Sonora/Chihuahua/Coahuila solar; Oaxaca/Tehuantepec wind). 2023 industry estimates trend higher (~3.5%) per CRE confiabilidad reports. Anchor held at 1.2 TWh as a midpoint of PRODESEN-2022 (~1.0) and CRE-2023 (~3.5%-implied ~3 TWh). Hydro vertimientos NOT included in this figure — varies dramatically with annual hydrology. Sources: PRODESEN https://www.gob.mx/sener/documentos/programa-de-desarrollo-del-sistema-electrico-nacional-2024-2038 + CRE https://www.gob.mx/cre — Gemini-3.1 research wave 2 (2026-04-30).
